gap: Scoping is clean (BHD unchanged), but the shell loses on its own merits. Desktop topbar: 760px of its 1364px width (56%) is a zero-height empty spacer -- no wordmark, no page title, no context -- while the right end crams 8 controls in 4 icon languages including a muted-speaker-with-x that reads as an error state; Wave's header carries its wordmark and hands the page a large confident 'Transactions' H1. Rail: 76px wide with 17 nav items and 0 visible labels, versus Wave's curated 11, and it carries two competing active treatments at once (a saturated blue filled square on the Favorites star, a pale tint on the actual current page) plus the BHD logo inside the Paper & Pen scope. Mobile shell has no product identity or page title at all, and the fixed 48x48 floating button at x=330,y=784 overlaps the bottom tab bar and occludes the 'More' label. The desktop list table is genuinely good; the shell around it is not.
